scripts.setup:prototype: npm run mode:prototype && npm run setup:local
scripts.setup:live: npm run mode:live && npm run infra:up && npm run verify:setup && npm run migrate
scripts.start:prototype: npm run ports:free && npm run setup:prototype && npm run dev:local
scripts.start:live: npm run ports:free && npm run setup:live && npm run dev:local
scripts.stack:up: docker compose up --build -d postgres redis api worker web
scripts.stack:up:proxy: docker compose --profile proxy up --build -d traefik postgres redis api worker web
scripts.dev:local: concurrently "npm run dev -w @integration/api" "npm run worker -w @integration/api" "npm run dev -w @integration/web"
scripts.dev:prototype: npm run mode:prototype && npm run dev:local
scripts.dev:live: npm run mode:live && npm run dev:local
scripts.dev:prototype:clean: npm run ports:free && npm run dev:prototype
scripts.dev:live:clean: npm run ports:free && npm run dev:live
scripts.test:local:prototype: npm run verify:setup && npm run smoke:prototype
scripts.test:local:live: npm run verify:setup && npm run smoke:live
scripts.stack:logs: docker compose logs -f api worker web
